scope: 18-case inspected development regression: six reused public Kaggle cases and twelve root-authored synthetic messages; two cleaned historical hits per request maximum
source: Public Kaggle thoughtvector/customer-support-on-twitter corpus already in the public repository, plus synthetic messages authored in this task
limitation: Pattern scan is not a universal sensitive-data detector. No private workplace support records are used. Reserved final/challenge text is used only locally for exclusions, not submitted as inference input.
